title: Knot polynomials on braid closures
abstract: We explore properties of the Jones and Alexander polynomials of braid closures of braids of index 3. We analyze how the evaluations of these polynomials at t = −1 force implications regarding the topological structure of the braid closure, such as its number of circles or the existence of splittings. As a consequence, we construct an infinite number of pairs of distinct non-split links that have the same HOMFLYPT polynomial.
